wire.headline: Aldbury Council Reverses Infrastructure Bond Withdrawal After 9-4 Vote
sentences: Aldbury District Council voted 9-4 to scrap its 12% budget cut plan.
The decision reverses a proposal to withdraw 4.26bn GBP in infrastructure bonds.
Cllr Marian Holt described the vote as a historic correction of fiscal error.
Local housing shares jumped 18p following the immediate relief announcement.
Full implementation is scheduled for the March 2027 financial cycle start.
Opposition MP Gareth Vane demanded an independent audit of the savings.
